Card Q&A.a: No, you can't.If its DP is reduced to 0 and it is deleted when played, you can't activate the [On Play] effect. Also, the "By deleting this Digimon" condition is not fulfilled when this Digimon is deleted by another effect or rule.
Card Q&A.q: When this card was played, an already activated DP-reducing effect reduced this card's DP to 0 and deleted it. In such cases, can I activate the [On Play] effect by considering the "By deleting this Digimon" condition to be fulfilled?

Effect: [On Play] By deleting this Digimon, reveal the top 5 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Bagra Army] in its traits among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
[On Deletion] ＜Save＞ (You may place this card under one of your Tamers.)
Inherited Effect: [Opponent's Turn] When an effect trashes this card from digivolution cards, gain 1 memory.
